newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's GiroCredit interested in Hungary's MTB.
newsitem.headline: Austria's GiroCredit interested in Hungary's MTB.

text.p: Austria's GiroCredit Bank said on Friday it was interested in participating in the tender for Hungary's Magyar Takarek Bank (MTB).

The public offering for Hungary's majority state-owned retail bank is expected this year, said GiroCredit chief executive Ferdinand Lacina on the sidelines of a financial symposium in this Tyrolean village.
"We can afford it," he said, but declined to elaborate on the expected price tag.
Lacina said GiroCredit would pitch for the bank without its parent company Bank Austria AG. -- Guenter Kornfeld, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 275
